name: The Deep Drift
blurb: Below the lanes the Drift goes on, and something in it is alive. Great slow shapes follow the old gate wakes, and where they feed the wrecks are picked clean and polished like teeth. There are no stations, no patrols, no pirates. The deep is quiet, and every long note it sounds is a question. Meeting a Leviathan unprepared ends a run; meeting one well can end the fear of them.
